DailyCourse.title: DailyCourse
DailyCourse.description: A canonical seeded daily movement course identified by UTC date key.

dateKey.description: UTC calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

seed.description: Canonical deterministic seed string for generating course geometry.

segmentCount.description: Total generated movement segments between Start and Finish.

mechanics.description: Bounded list of movement segment types featured in this course (max 8).

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag for daily archive listing.

createdBy.description: UID of the authenticated player who first registered the daily record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily course record was registered.

DailyRun.title: DailyRun
DailyRun.description: An authenticated player's personal best leaderboard entry on a specific daily course.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the runner (matches document ID).

dateKey.description: Parent daily course UTC date key.

displayName.description: Public runner display name shown on the leaderboard.

bestTime.description: Fastest finish time in seconds (strictly positive, <= 3600).

splits.description: Bounded list of gate split timestamps in seconds (max 32).

isPublic.description: Public visibility flag for leaderboard listing.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of initial submission.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest personal best improvement.

/dailyCourses/{dateKey}.description: Shared daily course registry indexed by UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

/dailyCourses/{dateKey}/runs/{uid}.description: Per-player personal best leaderboard records for each daily course.
